comment: The headliner was hilarious, I was crying laughing the whole set.
Two-drink minimum and the cheapest drink was $14. Felt like a shakedown.
Show started 45 minutes late and nobody told us why.
The opener's jokes were just tired airplane material. Headliner saved it, barely.
A drunk guy behind us kept grabbing my girlfriend's shoulder and security did nothing when we told them.
Great comics, but we were stuck behind a pillar and couldn't see the stage.
Oh wonderful, $40 a ticket to hear a guy read his phone notes. Loved it.
Do you have a 21+ policy or can I bring my 19 year old?
Our server forgot our order twice and we waited 30 minutes for fries.
Ticketmaster fees were almost as much as the ticket itself.
I got sick after the chicken wings, was up all night.
Host was quick on his feet, handled a heckler like a pro.
The mic kept cutting out during the second comic.
Parking was a nightmare. Took 20 minutes to find a spot.
Cocktails were actually great, and the nachos were huge.
They canceled the show an hour before and I still haven't gotten my refund.
The bouncer made a comment about my accent at the door. Not okay.
Best date night we've had in months.
